title: Convert DR exercise evidence into maintained readiness
question: How does an exercise observation become a verified, owned, and retested recovery improvement?
scenario: A tabletop shows that the alternate site contact is no longer employed. The owner updates a contact list but does not test the backup channel or the supplier's escalation path.
focalRelation: observation --expected/actual evidence--> finding finding --owner/priority/due date--> action plan action --changes plan/architecture/training/contract--> candidate capability retest --verifies--> closure risk acceptance --bounded owner/review date--> open residual risk

nodes.label: Exercise observation
nodes.detail: Alternate-site contact is no longer employed; observed fact is preserved separately from interpretation.

nodes.label: Classified DR finding
nodes.detail: People and communications capability gap with impact, scope, evidence, and status.

nodes.label: Corrective-action owner
nodes.detail: Primary accountable owner, alternate owner, due date, priority, and escalation.

nodes.label: Updated contact plan
nodes.detail: Version-controlled plan change replacing the contact and supplier escalation details.

nodes.label: Backup-channel retest
nodes.detail: Observed activation of alternate owner, approved channel, and supplier escalation under exercise conditions.

nodes.label: Readiness evidence
nodes.detail: Closure record showing the capability works, remaining limits, communication status, and next maintenance trigger.

edges.label: is evaluated and classified as capability gap
is assigned with due date and escalation
produces closure or reopened finding evidence

states.title: Case facts fixed
states.caption: A tabletop shows that the alternate site contact is no longer employed. The owner updates a contact list but does not test the backup channel or the supplier's escalation path.

states.title: Controlling condition identified
states.caption: Evidence should support both what happened and what the exercise could not test.

states.title: Tempting shortcut rejected
states.caption: Updating the DR document closes a failed exercise finding. A document update is only closure when the underlying capability, ownership, or decision has been made executable and retested.

states.title: Bounded action applied
states.caption: Classify the issue as a people and communication capability gap, assign a primary and alternate owner, test the approved channels, update the plan version, and retest contact activation. Evidence must show that the team can reach the decision authority during an event, not only that a name was replaced.

statuses.n5: backup channel and supplier path exercised

states.title: Outcome accepted with limits
states.caption: Given DR exercise evidence, classify findings, assign corrective action, communicate status, update the plan, and define a retest that demonstrates closure. The case record retains the scope, owner, exceptions, and evidence used for this conclusion.

variants.label: Changed case
variants.changedFact: A full-interruption exercise was stopped safely, but the recovery team did not test customer communications or regulator notification.

states.title: Changed case fact isolated
states.caption: A full-interruption exercise was stopped safely, but the recovery team did not test customer communications or regulator notification.

states.title: Decision recomputed
states.caption: Record the exercise as partially successful, assign communication and regulatory actions, update the scope and contact plan, and schedule a targeted retest. A safe stop is valuable evidence but does not prove the untested stakeholder path.

states.title: Changed outcome verified
states.caption: The decision remains provisional until the changed dependency, enforcement result, and accountable evidence are verified.

nodes.label: Safely stopped interruption exercise
nodes.detail: The team demonstrated stop authority and safe termination.

nodes.label: Untested communications gap
nodes.detail: Customer messaging and regulator notification were outside execution.

nodes.label: Communications corrective owner
nodes.detail: A named owner updates triggers, templates, approvals, and contact routes.

nodes.label: Customer and regulator contact plan
nodes.detail: The maintained plan defines authority, audiences, channels, timing, and alternates.

nodes.label: Communications retest
nodes.detail: A bounded exercise validates message approval, delivery, fallback, and evidence.

nodes.label: Updated readiness evidence
nodes.detail: The report separates proven interruption controls from newly tested communications.

prediction.prompt: How does an exercise observation become a verified, owned, and retested recovery improvement?

options.label: Updating the DR document closes a failed exercise finding.
options.feedback: Incorrect: A document update is only closure when the underlying capability, ownership, or decision has been made executable and retested.

options.label: Assign the gap, test both contact paths, update the plan, and retest activation
options.feedback: Correct for this scenario: this answer uses the displayed relation and preserves its scope. A document update is only closure when the underlying capability, ownership, or decision has been made executable and retested.

options.label: Close the exercise finding after replacing the old contact name in the plan.
options.feedback: Incorrect: the edit does not establish that the backup channel or supplier escalation works. Assign an owner, test the changed path, capture evidence, and maintain the plan from the result.

prediction.hint: Name the controlling relationship and the point where its result must be enforced; do not rely on a label or successful prior step.

transfer.prompt: A full-interruption exercise was stopped safely, but the recovery team did not test customer communications or regulator notification.

options.label: Reuse the original conclusion because the overall control family is unchanged
options.feedback: Changed fact: A full-interruption exercise was stopped safely, but the recovery team did not test customer communications or regulator notification. Why this answer fails: “Reuse the original conclusion because the overall control family is unchanged” does not account for that changed condition. Corrected consequence: Classify the issue as a people and communication capability gap, assign a primary and alternate owner, test the approved channels, update the plan version, and retest contact activation. Repair target: Decision recomputed — Record the exercise as partially successful, assign communication and regulatory actions, update the scope and contact plan, and schedule a targeted retest. A safe stop is valuable evidence but does not prove the untested stakeholder path.

options.label: Bypass the normal owner and apply a permanent broad restriction immediately
options.feedback: Changed fact: A full-interruption exercise was stopped safely, but the recovery team did not test customer communications or regulator notification. Why this answer fails: “Bypass the normal owner and apply a permanent broad restriction immediately” does not account for that changed condition. Corrected consequence: Classify the issue as a people and communication capability gap, assign a primary and alternate owner, test the approved channels, update the plan version, and retest contact activation. Repair target: Changed outcome verified — The decision remains provisional until the changed dependency, enforcement result, and accountable evidence are verified.

options.label: Record the exercise as partially successful, assign communication and regulatory actions
options.feedback: Correct. Record the exercise as partially successful, assign communication and regulatory actions, update the scope and contact plan, and schedule a targeted retest. A safe stop is valuable evidence but does not prove the untested stakeholder path.

transfer.hint: Trace the changed fact to the exact decision boundary, then identify the evidence needed before the outcome can be accepted.

retry.prompt: A recovery finding is marked closed after the runbook is edited, but the failed procedure has not been exercised again. What status is justified?

options.label: Record the corrective action as implemented but keep effectiveness open until a scoped retest passes
options.feedback: Correct. Retest evidence distinguishes edited instructions from restored capability.

options.label: Close the finding because the approved runbook now contains the correct steps
options.feedback: Approval proves the document changed, not that people and systems can execute it.

options.label: Reopen every prior exercise finding because one procedure has not been retested
options.feedback: Track the affected finding and dependencies; unrelated closed evidence need not be discarded.

retry.hint: A document change is an action; closure depends on evidence that the capability now works.

takeaway: Classify the issue as a people and communication capability gap, assign a primary and alternate owner, test the approved channels, update the plan version, and retest contact activation.
assumptions: The scenario is a bounded application of the canonical unit, not a universal threshold, legal conclusion, or vendor prescription.
Directed edges carry only their printed relation; proximity and shared color do not imply ownership, authorization, or chronology.
Acceptance applies only to the stated scope and retained evidence; unknown or excluded conditions remain explicit.

treatmentDispositions.rationale: Implemented in 5 stable state states: Exercise observation is evaluated and classified as capability gap Classified DR finding; Classified DR finding is assigned with due date and escalation Corrective-action owner. The model keeps Exercise observation, Classified DR finding, Corrective-action owner, Updated contact plan, Backup-channel retest, Readiness evidence distinct. Its changed case is “A full-interruption exercise was stopped safely, but the recovery team did not test customer communications or regulator notification.” and every option returns to a named repair state.

learningJob.plainExplanation: Updating a plan does not close a capability failure. Assign the finding, change the executable capability, preserve evidence, update the plan, and retest the failed condition.
learningJob.visualReasoningGain: The finding-to-capability sequence makes ownership, corrective action, evidence, plan update, and retest closure traceable.
